ns2:section.sectionText: Career Launchpad: Job Search Strategies for Graduate Students. This graduate-level course is designed to equip students with the essential skills and knowledge to navigate today's competitive job market. The course will provide a comprehensive overview of effective job search strategies, tailored specifically to the needs and challenges of graduate students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MENG:Mechanical Enginerng-UIUC, MENG:Elec & Computer Eng-UIUC, MENG:Engineerng:Enrgy Sys-UIUC, MENG:Bioeng:Gen Bioeng -UIUC, MENG:Bioeng:Bioinstrument-UIUC, MENG:Engr:Aerospace Sys - UIUC, MENG:Engineering:Plasma-UIUC, MENG:Engr:AutonomyRobotic-UIUC, MENG:ENGR:Instrmnt & AP - UIUC, or MENG:Engr:Chem Engr Lead-UIUC.
